maddeler.e:
اقتطعن (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَعْنَ (iqtaṭaʕna) /iq.ta.tˤaʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اُقْتُطِعْنَ (uqtuṭiʕna) /uq.tu.tˤiʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
# اِقْتَطِعْنَ (iqtaṭiʕna) /iq.ta.tˤiʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِقْتَطَعَ (iqtaṭaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
